name: STIHL
legalEntityNote: STIHL is a family-owned group with several legal entities, including the founding company Andreas Stihl AG & Co. KG and the holding company Stihl Holding AG & Co. KG. Product, importer, dealer and factory responsibility varies by market and SKU.
headline: STIHL ownership, outdoor cleaning equipment and specialist-dealer network
description: A source-backed profile of STIHL's family ownership, outdoor-power and cleaning-equipment portfolio, manufacturing network and authorized dealer model.
metaDescription: STIHL profile: family ownership, wet-dry vacuums, outdoor power equipment, global manufacturing, dealers and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with STIHL. Group figures and network disclosures must not be treated as a factory or warranty statement for every SKU.

ownership.summary: STIHL is a family-owned, non-listed group. Its 2025 reporting describes Stihl Holding AG & Co. KG as the group holding company and Andreas Stihl AG & Co. KG as the founding company. This ownership structure is distinct from an individual dealer, importer or regional sales subsidiary.

leadership.name: Andreas Stihl
leadership.context: STIHL traces the group to Andreas Stihl's 1926 foundation in Germany.

productPortfolio.name: Forestry, landscape and garden equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Core professional and consumer outdoor power tools across gasoline and battery formats.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify user segment, power source, safety requirements and authorized servicing route.

productPortfolio.name: Battery systems and charging platforms
productPortfolio.positioning: A growing cordless offer for professional and private users.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm battery-system compatibility, charger specification and local warranty coverage.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-dry vacuums and dust extractors
productPortfolio.positioning: Workshop, vehicle, construction and outdoor-maintenance cleaning equipment.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match dust class, outlet/tool activation, filter specification and regional electrical rating.

productPortfolio.name: Digital services and dealer support
productPortfolio.positioning: Connected solutions and specialist dealer support complement the equipment range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Validate local service competence, replacement-parts availability and account access.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: STIHL reports manufacturing in eight countries and legally independent production companies within a global network.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the producing entity and country of origin on the exact product label and declaration.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The group says its production companies manufacture components and finished goods, while certain operations also serve external customers.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not infer that every STIHL-branded product is made at the same facility or by one group entity.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Wet-dry vacuum and dust-extractor product pages define product-level specifications.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the model suffix, accessory bundle and destination voltage before ordering.

marketsChannels.evidence: STIHL reports 40 sales and marketing companies, around 100 importers and more than 50,000 independent dealers in more than 160 countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized importer and servicing dealer for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: The group describes authorized servicing dealers as its core route to end users alongside expanding own online shops.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Check whether online or retail purchasing preserves installation, service and warranty support.

marketsChannels.evidence: Products are designed for professional and consumer uses with local safety and configuration requirements.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify local compliance, operator training and parts support.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: STIHL's edge is its dense specialist-dealer network and an outdoor-equipment portfolio that now spans battery, professional cleaning and digital services. The buyer risk is assuming that a familiar global mark equals universal support: product origin, authorised service and battery configuration still need model-level confirmation.
